inquiries_source_fk_matches_type.name: inquiries_source_fk_matches_type
inquiries_source_fk_matches_type.value:
(
        ("inquiries"."source_type" = 'student' AND "inquiries"."project_id" IS NULL AND (
          ("inquiries"."student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."student_profile_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."source_id" = "inquiries"."student_id")
          OR
          ("inquiries"."student_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."student_profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."source_id" = "inquiries"."student_profile_id"::text)
        ))
        OR
        ("inquiries"."source_type" = 'project' AND "inquiries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inquiries"."student_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."student_profile_id" IS NULL AND "inquiries"."source_id" = "inquiries"."project_id")
      )

project_join_requests_response_check.name: project_join_requests_response_check
project_join_requests_response_check.value: ("project_join_requests"."state" = 'pending' AND "project_join_requests"."responded_at" IS NULL AND "project_join_requests"."responded_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "project_join_requests"."membership_id" IS NULL) OR ("project_join_requests"."state" IN ('approved','declined') AND "project_join_requests"."responded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_join_requests"."responded_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND (("project_join_requests"."state" = 'approved' AND "project_join_requests"."membership_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_join_requests"."state" = 'declined' AND "project_join_requests"."membership_id" IS NULL)))

project_memberships_acceptance_check.name: project_memberships_acceptance_check
project_memberships_acceptance_check.value: ("project_memberships"."state" IN ('accepted', 'removed') AND "project_memberships"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_memberships"."state" IN ('pending', 'declined') AND "project_memberships"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

project_memberships_removal_check.name: project_memberships_removal_check
project_memberships_removal_check.value: "project_memberships"."state" <> 'removed' OR ("project_memberships"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "project_memberships"."removed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

projects_origin_owner_check.name: projects_origin_owner_check
projects_origin_owner_check.value: ("projects"."origin" = 'legacy_fixture' AND "projects"."maintainer_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("projects"."origin" = 'student' AND "projects"."maintainer_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("projects"."origin" = 'admin' AND "projects"."maintainer_user_id" IS NULL)

studio_acceptance_check.name: studio_acceptance_check
studio_acceptance_check.value: ("studio_submissions"."accepted_version" IS NULL AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_by" IS NULL AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_project_version" IS NULL) OR ("studio_submissions"."accepted_version" IS NOT NULL AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_project_version" IS NOT NULL AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_project_version" > 0)

studio_publish_check.name: studio_publish_check
studio_publish_check.value: NOT "studio_submissions"."published" OR ("studio_submissions"."state" = 'approved' AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_version" = "studio_submissions"."content_version" AND "studio_submissions"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL)

studio_content_check.name: studio_content_check
studio_content_check.value: length("studio_submissions"."title") BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND length("studio_submissions"."summary") BETWEEN 1 AND 4000 AND length("studio_submissions"."media_url") <= 2048 AND length("studio_submissions"."demo_url") <= 2048
